stage: registered after the R2 pilots (seeds 777002-777005, instances outside every released or new suite) and before any R2 run on a released suite, before generating the new suites, before any R2 reference computation and before any R2 scoring
why: responses to an independent review of the R1 manuscript: headroom claims (budget extension, harder tier), shortcut and composition analyses, reference independence, overhead, coverage (real hosts with real labels), a generic SAT baseline, and a synthetic held-out split

idcon_hard_x.note: decoy_s left out (decided by the observation tables; Amendment 1)

idcon_hard_h.release: held out: inputs, construction maps and references stay with the authors; manifest hashes, input hashes and the SHA-256 of the reference file are published (commitment); no method is run on it in R2

idcon_cite.hosts: Cora (2,708 vertices, 7 labels) and PubMed (19,717 vertices, 3 labels) from github.com/kimiyoung/planetoid commit af6abf4 (MIT); not redistributed
idcon_cite.queries: random-walk induced subgraphs, k in {8,16,24}, dense (avg degree >= 3) and sparse, 8 per set and host (96 ancestors)

new.sat_cadical: sat_baseline.py: identity space encoded to CNF (independent/cnf_encoding.py), two-query reduction with selector unit clauses, one CaDiCaL 2.1.3 process per query, killed at the budget; witnesses replayed

methods.idcon_hard_x_note: Trad-CP, Enum-VF2 and ASP-cautious are not run on IdCon-Hard-X: on IdCon-Hard they answer 214, 14 and 15 of 1,008 runs at 2 s; compute is spent on longer budgets instead
methods.released_suites: sat_cadical on IdCon-Hard, IdCon-HPRD and IdCon-HPRD-X (2 s, two repeats)

runs.calib: 50 seeded IdCon-Hard tasks x {LAD, Glasgow --staged}, repeat 0, 2 s, on the R2 machine; compared with the frozen v1 records (speed ratio, outcome agreement)
runs.hardx_60s: IdCon-Hard-X, LAD / Glasgow --staged / SAT pairs unanswered at 10 s, 60 s
runs.cite_10s: IdCon-Cite, pairs unanswered in a 2 s repeat for LAD, Glasgow --staged, CP-SAT, ASP-cautious, SAT; 10 s, repeat 0
runs.hard_60s: IdCon-Hard repeat 0: LAD and Glasgow --staged on every pair not answered correctly at 2 s or 10 s; CP-SAT on every task that no method answered at 2 s or 10 s; 60 s
runs.sat_released: sat_cadical on IdCon-Hard, IdCon-HPRD, IdCon-HPRD-X, 2 s, two repeats
runs.overhead: first query (exists T in {S,U,V}) of LAD2025 and Glasgow --staged on 48 IdCon-Hard tasks (8 per tier x variant): total, solver process wall time, outside-solver time, solver-reported time
runs.process_model: two executors pinned to one vCPU each (taskset); jobs on 16,384-entity hosts never run concurrently with each other (memory); timed jobs first, then pairs, extended budgets, then untimed jobs (references, independent check), then the overhead job alone

machine.note: 2 vCPU / 8 GB cloud VM, not the R1 VM; see calib
machine.stack: unlimited (LAD2025 segfaults on 16,384-entity hosts with 8 MB)

references.new_suites: hard_benchmark.reference_task (LAD2025 30 s per state, Glasgow corroboration 30 s; LAD timeouts fall back to Glasgow 60 s then CP-SAT 60 s; construction-map replay for synthetic suites); the independent check below is the second engine

independent_check.code: experiment/independent/ (cnf_encoding.py, idcheck.py): imports nothing from experiment/src
independent_check.procedure: per task, the three exact-state queries T(y)=S,U,V: witness search on an arc-consistent CNF, witness replayed against the raw JSON; a negative answer is re-derived on the CNF without arc consistency with a DRAT proof checked by drat-trim; no-search negatives only for an empty domain (anchors, unary domains, degree bound, tables) or no entity in the queried state; 600 s per solve, 1,200 s per proof check
independent_check.sample: IdCon-Hard: every task with a negative state not confirmed by a second engine in R1, plus 8 seeded tasks per tier x variant stratum (48); IdCon-HPRD-X: every task ASP-cautious did not answer; IdCon-Cite and IdCon-Hard-X: every task

registered_r2: IdCon-Hard VBS at 2 s, 10 s and 60 s (repeat 0) over the sound methods, with and without Glasgow --staged; LAD at 10 s and 60 s
IdCon-Hard-X and IdCon-Cite main tables (correct / wrong / unanswered, ancestor-equal PAR-2 at the run budget, correct by label), with the three no-search priors
independent-check agreement table (agree / disagree / unresolved, by suite and why)
calibration of the R2 machine against v1 records
amendment_5_posthoc: disclosure of the two solvers removed by Amendment 4 (EG-ICAF, LAD-SV: the authors' own, unpublished methods): frozen-record results on IdCon-Hard and IdCon-HPRD and their effect on the VBS (appendix; not ranked)
IdCon-Hard sensitivity: without the decoy_s control (432 tasks) and without the tasks whose label the tables decide up to non-emptiness (non-perturbed, two states excluded by the tables)
embedding multiplicity corrected for query automorphisms (IdCon-HPRD)
stratum comparisons: differences whose bootstrap interval includes 0 reported as not distinguishable
runtime errors per method and suite
overlap of the three priors' errors
analyses.note: the R1 primary analysis (504 IdCon-Hard tasks, decoy_s included) stays the primary analysis; the sensitivity analyses are post hoc
